phases.objective: Keep the canonical tenant-request inbox readable across legacy utf8mb4 collation drift while introducing a bounded alignment migration and a read-only governed readiness lifecycle for inbox-owned identity columns.

e2e_journeys.actor: platform admin or authenticated tenant member
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ticket, latest lifecycle activity, and the latest resolution case are resolved without ER_CANT_AGGREGATE_2COLLATIONS and without weakening tenant scope.
steps: Read actual utf8mb4 collations of indexed tenant-resolution and lifecycle identity columns from information_schema and reject unknown collations.
Keep indexed dependent-table columns bare while converting only outer ticket expressions to the indexed column collation.
Preserve bounded candidate discovery and latest-activity ordering.

Restore ticket_lifecycle_events ticket/tenant identity to canonical utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci and align tenant_resolution_cases relational tenant_id/ticket_id keys to the same ticket-domain collation through a separately governed source migration.
Leave tickets and non-relational tenant_resolution_cases resource_ref/default collation unchanged.
assertions: Indexed resolution-case and lifecycle identity columns are never wrapped in CONVERT/COLLATE in inbox joins.
Outer ticket expressions are normalized to the actual indexed-column collation with an explicit two-collation fail-closed allowlist.
The migration keeps ticket_lifecycle_events on utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci and aligns only tenant_resolution_cases tenant_id/ticket_id relational keys to that ticket-domain collation.
The migration source does not alter tickets or tenant_resolution_cases resource_ref.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Trusted-main tooling emits a no-secret, read-only readiness classification without migration Apply, capability authorization, provider dispatch, credential access, or database mutation.
steps: Pin the reviewed migration blob, SHA-256 checksum, statement count, source merge SHA, and exact trusted-main checkout.
Read current Production ref and public runtime parity without mutating Production.
Use the canonical admin-control DB read builder to inspect INFORMATION_SCHEMA column/table collations and the exact governed migration ledger row with SELECT-only requests.
Classify already_applied_verified, ready_to_authorize_dry_run, blocked_on_production_promotion, or a fail-closed schema/ledger/runtime state.
Record tenant_resolution_cases.resource_ref metadata as non-relational evidence while the migration source remains forbidden from altering that column.
assertions: The readiness workflow has contents: read permission and only runs from trusted main for the exact Issue #4449 token.
Every database request is produced by buildAdminControlDbReadRequest and carries read_only=true.
The readiness runner never invokes governed_migration_execute, creates/approves a Capability Envelope, or sends an Apply confirmation.
Production source absence is reported as blocked_on_production_promotion rather than bypassed with direct SQL or an untrusted branch execution.
